purpose: EV-01..EV-05 are the stable labels of the five events in data/analytics-plan.json, not a second wire protocol. Browser JSON uses the canonical event names and allow-listed IDs accepted by analytics/collector.py. No production totals are available.
why_nothing_is_sending: GitHub Pages is static hosting, not a Python runtime. The first-party /api/analytics/events collector must run on a verified same-origin host before any production event can be accepted.
The browser switch and deployment gates remain false. Tests use synthetic events and isolated temporary databases; test results never enter the campaign ledger.
A correct application cannot control hosting-platform security logs. Deployment requires a reviewed privacy notice and host/proxy logging policy.
Associates order totals are available only from an authorised account report, not from a reader click. No authorised report has been imported.

implementation.client: analytics/client.js is the reviewed source; build.py copies it byte-for-byte to assets/analytics.js. It observes trusted marked links, including the supplied short links, without inventing an ASIN.
implementation.switch: data/config.json analytics and data/analytics-plan.json collection must agree; deployment and privacy flags must pass. Only indexable reader pages may load the client.
implementation.endpoint_source: analytics/collector.py is the supported same-origin Python/SQLite collector. It accepts only bounded JSON with canonical event names, known page/product IDs and a fixed reading bucket, then increments UTC-day aggregates. Legacy PHP/Worker endpoints are retired and return 410.
implementation.guard: check_analytics_consistency checks event names against the actual collector allow-list, deployment flags, script placement, privacy wording and banned identifying APIs.
implementation.verification: tests/test_analytics_contract.py executes the actual client in a Node harness, posts its payloads to the real Python handler in an isolated database, and checks opt-outs, synthetic activations, engagement and rejection rules.
implementation.what_is_not_shipped: A production runtime, authorised account reports and Search Console access are not configured. A passing synthetic test is not traffic, a live collector, an order or revenue.

privacy_rules: The client reads no cookies, persistent storage, reader IDs, referrer, query string or full outbound URL. It uses fetch with credentials omitted and no-referrer policy, never a credentialed beacon.
Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable measurement. Only marked primary/middle-button product activations are counted; scripts cannot manufacture an outbound navigation.
The collector rejects unknown fields and non-canonical page/product IDs. It computes the UTC date on the server and stores only daily aggregate counts, not raw event rows.

Request transport necessarily exposes connection information to infrastructure. The application suppresses access logs, but host/proxy logs need a separate review. GitHub Pages itself documents IP logging for security.
EV-05 cannot be sent by a browser. Import only authorised first-party aggregates, retain provenance, and never join click counts to an inferred order or a visitor.

events.name: page_view
events.fires_when: One event when an indexable publication page first becomes visible, per page load, after explicit enablement. DNT and Global Privacy Control opt out. This is a page load, not a unique human/session count.
events.note: Canonical wire format: event and page_id; target_id or the fixed 60s bucket only where defined. Counts are not unique people, eligible sessions or conversions.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: One trusted primary or middle-button activation of an explicitly marked supplied-product link. The recorded link/product ID is not an inferred ASIN or proof of the intended listing.
events.note: Canonical wire format: event and page_id; target_id or the fixed 60s bucket only where defined. Counts are not unique people, eligible sessions or conversions.

events.name: article_engagement
events.fires_when: One event after 60 visible-and-focused one-second intervals on a published article or buying guide. Hidden tabs do not accumulate intervals. This is coarse engagement, not proof that the article was finished.
events.note: Canonical wire format: event and page_id; target_id or the fixed 60s bucket only where defined. Counts are not unique people, eligible sessions or conversions.

events.name: comparison_interaction
events.fires_when: One trusted activation of a marked product-detail link from compare.html; the target is an allow-listed product ID. Merely seeing a table does not emit this event.
events.note: Canonical wire format: event and page_id; target_id or the fixed 60s bucket only where defined. Counts are not unique people, eligible sessions or conversions.

events.name: affiliate_report_import
events.fires_when: An authorized Associates Central report is imported; the corresponding aggregate is added to data/campaign-ledger.json.
events.note: Operator-only aggregate report import; the repository ledger is empty.

campaign_ledger.note: Started empty on purpose, per the brief's 'empty but well-defined campaign ledger'. A row may only be added from an authorised first-party report. No conversion score and no revenue forecast is presented anywhere in this repository.
campaign_ledger.why_empty: No authorised first-party report has been imported. Synthetic contract tests are excluded and a click is not an order.

prerequisites.owner_action: Provision a same-origin HTTPS runtime and /api/analytics/events route for analytics/collector.py.
prerequisites.why: GitHub Pages serves static assets and cannot run the collector.

prerequisites.owner_action: Verify the privacy notice, retention, and hosting/proxy logs; record the deployment evidence and enable both guarded switches.
prerequisites.why: Program Policies §3(e) requires accurate technology disclosure; code cannot certify infrastructure it does not control.

prerequisites.owner_action: Confirm the selected tracking ID in Associates Central, test one link per intended listing, and obtain an authorised aggregate report.
prerequisites.why: Account access and reports are not available to this repository. The selected ID remains recorded but not applied.
